label: POST-HOC SENSITIVITY CONTROL
context_policy: original frozen M1-H64 selected_L, shared by AR and ARX; no context tuning
selection_metric: native-unit inner-validation MAE, equally averaged over frozen horizons, after frozen inversion/projection
tie_break: smaller alpha (existing stable selector at fixed context)
preprocessing: unchanged frozen source transforms and training-only robust resource scaler, followed by existing RidgeForecaster training-only lag-feature StandardScaler
target_training: frozen transformed and robust-scaled target, direct multi-output horizons
persistence: last own-resource observed native value, per-cell 1-MAE/persistence_MAE then equal entity-fold and horizon averaging; undefined zero denominator omitted with explicit counts as frozen pandas mean semantics
aggregation: equal entity-fold native MAE per lead then equal frozen horizons; no pooling across blocks
statistics: authorised per-block/resource ARX:AR gain and descriptive sign/magnitude comparison with frozen S2:S1 only
